out_of_engine_mechanics.name: CurJackpotStoreWin progressive (test-interface-zeroed)
out_of_engine_mechanics.desc: Field 'CurJackpotStoreWin' is present on every ST1/ST5 round but =0 on 100% of the 42616 in-sample records. FLEET-WIDE test-interface behavior (user-confirmed 2026-06-12, recorded once per machine): it is a real progressive jackpot store, but the current testspin interface forces its accumulation to 0 (so the sample correctly shows 0). Parse the data as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in the ST1/ST5 signature, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE — when the test interface is optimized to populate it, the existing parser picks it up unchanged. The data RTP is the BASE RTP (excludes the progressive); it grows when the field is enabled.
